verdict.rationale: Namecheap is a domain registrar and DNS service, not an AI agent or assistant, so it has no role in which it would act as an MCP client consuming other servers' tools. That makes this story a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any MCP-client capability; the APIs, Go SDK and Terraform provider are developer building blocks unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
